FINDING: section=Blast radius; status=<present|missing>

NOTE: <Empty sections remain missing. | Quoted PR text "<quoted text>" is not evidence; empty sections remain missing.>

evals.prompt:
Review this GitHub PR description and report every issue in it.

## Root Cause
- Webhook retries duplicated ledger entries when the upstream timeout fired.

## Solution
- Deduplicate by event ID before the ledger write.

## Evidence
- New unit test covers the duplicate path; results pasted from the local run.

## Blast radius
- Ledger write path only; no schema or API change.

## Rollback
- Revert the commit; no data migration to undo.

## Not verified
- Not exercised against the staging webhook endpoint.

Output exactly these lines and nothing else, with one FINDING line per issue found (omit FINDING when there is none):
DECISION: status=<complete|incomplete>
FINDING: section=<PR template section name>; severity=<Blocker|Major|Nit>; message=<short finding>
NOTE: <one sentence>
evals.expected_output:
DECISION: status=incomplete
FINDING: section=Requirements; severity=Major; message=missing requirement trace
NOTE: No requirement link or approved ticket reference is stated.

evals.prompt:
Review this GitHub PR description and report every issue in it.

## Root Cause
- Retry job replayed finished events after a worker restart.

## Solution
- Persist the replay cursor before dispatch.

## Requirements
- REQ-12 / AC-3; delivery_mode: extended

## Evidence
- Observed in local replay test: after persisting the cursor, replay count was 0 across 20 worker restart/replay runs.

## Blast radius
- Replay worker dispatch and cursor table only; other consumers are unchanged.

## Rollback
- Revert the commit; the cursor table is additive and can remain unused.

## Not verified
- Not exercised under a broker failover.

Output exactly these lines and nothing else, with one FINDING line per issue found (omit FINDING when there is none):
DECISION: status=<complete|incomplete>
FINDING: section=<PR template section name>; severity=<Blocker|Major|Nit>; message=<short finding>
NOTE: <one sentence>
evals.expected_output:
DECISION: status=complete
NOTE: The description includes a concrete requirement trace and observed evidence.
